source_scope.OSHB: Leningrad/MT-family morphology and qere/ketiv evidence only
source_scope.limit: OSHB and UXLC are not independent textual traditions and cannot adjudicate MT against Greek, DSS, Syriac, Vulgate, or other versions.

evidence_only_guard.defer: Speaker identities, rare syntax, qinah analysis, and MT/LXX/DSS/versional differences remain deferred_human_or_external_ai; no witness is preferred.

form_audit.poem_2: 22 alphabetic stanzas, pe before ayin at 2.16-17
form_audit.poem_3: 66 lines, three per letter, pe before ayin at 3.46-51
form_audit.poem_4: 22 alphabetic stanzas, pe before ayin at 4.16-17
form_audit.meter: disputed/uneven qinah observations never decide a seam

macro_parent_alternatives.exact_larger_alternative: retain the complete alphabetic city lament

units.literary_form: observer-voiced city lament: desolation, reversal, exile, remembered former goods
units.deciding_marker: איכה opens sustained third-person feminine description; 1.7 completes memory/mockery before impurity language at 1.8
units.rejected_alternative: letter-by-letter chunks or 1.1-6; 1.7 completes the movement
units.risk: city/Judah/Zion referents and 1.6 ketiv מן בת/qere מבת do not fix speaker identity
units.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Aleph-zayin initials are intact; feminine suffixes and city vocabulary cohere; qere spacing and preposition affect phrasing only.

units.literary_form: defilement, humiliation, sanctuary violation, famine with embedded appeals
units.deciding_marker: חטא חטאה starts a new field; brief ראה appeals at 1.9b/1.11b remain embedded until sustained first person at 1.12
units.rejected_alternative: cuts at 1.9b or 1.11b; direct-speech punctuation and speaker allocation are uncertain
units.risk: 1.11 ketiv מחמודיהם/qere מחמדיהם and embedded speech can shift translation, not macro function
units.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Heth-kaph acrostic stanzas cohere through exposure, sanctuary, food, and see/look imperatives; prefer larger movement.

units.literary_form: personified city's first-person public lament
units.deciding_marker: לוא אליכם plus הביטו וראו opens sustained first-person suffering and closes with doubled eye/no-comforter language
units.rejected_alternative: isolate 1.12 or split fire/net/yoke/assembly/tears
units.risk: לוא, difficult נשקד at 1.14, divine-title translation, and punctuation remain uncertain
units.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Lamed-ayin stanzas preserve normal order; first-person suffixes and accumulating metaphors bind the movement.

units.literary_form: narrator bridge into Zion confession, distress prayer, enemy complaint, petition
units.deciding_marker: 1.17 third-person bridge and no-comforter motif introduce sustained first-person speech at 1.18 through tav closure
units.rejected_alternative: one-verse 1.17 chunk or split confession from petition
units.risk: voice at 1.17-18 and 1.18 ketiv עמים/qere העמים remain disputed; enemy petition is not theology authority
units.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Pe-tsade-qoph-resh-shin-tav complete poem 1 in normal ayin-pe order; qere article affects idiom only.

units.literary_form: divine-action destruction catalogue ending in silent civic mourning
units.deciding_marker: second איכה launches repeated action against city/sanctuary; 2.10 closes with elders and women sitting silent
units.rejected_alternative: split each action stanza or cut before 2.10
units.risk: divine agency/title translation and 2.2 ketiv לא/qere ולא remain non-authorizing
units.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Aleph-yod subject/effect chain, repeated destruction verbs, cult/civic terms, and feminine suffixes cohere.

units.literary_form: witness grief, Zion address, prophet critique, taunts, interpretive closure
units.deciding_marker: first-person bodily grief at 2.11 turns to second-person questions at 2.13, taunts, then 2.17 response
units.rejected_alternative: cuts at 2.13/15/16 or between pe and ayin 2.16-17
units.risk: speaker/addressee, bodily idioms, rare מדוחים, and 2.14 ketiv שביתך/qere שבותך are unresolved
units.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Kaph-ayin stanzas, including pe before ayin, form a grief/address/taunt/response sequence; no ordering history is selected.

units.literary_form: exhortation to unceasing lament and nocturnal prayer
units.deciding_marker: צעק and wall/Zion address lead to feminine imperative chain קומי רני שפכי שאי
units.rejected_alternative: fold into prior taunts or split the two imperatival stanzas
units.risk: 'their heart,' wall addressee, and 2.19 ketiv בליל/qere בלילה remain difficult
units.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Tsade-qoph pair cry, night/day, water, and lifted-hands imagery; qere does not change function.

units.literary_form: Zion's direct closing petition and atrocity catalogue
units.deciding_marker: ראה יהוה והביטה opens sustained second-person address through tav closure
units.rejected_alternative: split questions, street deaths, and terrors
units.risk: speaker and rare טפחים at 2.20 remain deferred; atrocity text decides no history/theology
units.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Resh-shin-tav close poem 2; imperatives and second-person verbs bind the petition.

units.literary_form: afflicted first-person speaker's escalating triple-acrostic complaint
units.deciding_marker: אני הגבר opens six complete three-line strophes ending in quoted loss of endurance/hope
units.rejected_alternative: six or eighteen atomized chunks or metaphor cuts
units.risk: speaker identity, divine pronouns, and 3.10 ketiv אריה/qere ארי remain unresolved
units.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Aleph-vav triple strophes and repeated first-person objects bind the escalation; no Jeremiah/corporate identity is inferred.

units.literary_form: remembrance pivot from wormwood to mercy language and hope
units.deciding_marker: zayin זכר remembrance reaches 3.21 recall/hope; heth stanza states the recalled ground and portion/hope
units.rejected_alternative: isolate famous 3.22-24 or attach 3.19-21 backward
units.risk: חסדי יהוה כי לא תמנו at 3.22 has major translation/person-number pressure
units.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Complete zayin and heth strophes; זכר, הוחיל, חסדי/רחמי, נפשי make one pivot; no vocalization is preferred.

units.literary_form: wisdom-like waiting, bearing, silence, grief, compassion reflection
units.deciding_marker: three טוב openings, three yod instructions, and three כי rationale clauses form premise/posture/reason
units.rejected_alternative: split 3.25-27, 28-30, or isolate 31-33
units.risk: jussive/indicative force and 3.32 ketiv חסדו/qere חסדיו affect translation, not a doctrine of suffering
units.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Tet-yod-kaph strophes stay whole; lexical and syntactic repetition binds them.

units.literary_form: infinitive injustice catalogue and sovereignty/complaint questions
units.deciding_marker: three ל infinitives in 3.34-36 pair with three mem interrogatives in 3.37-39
units.rejected_alternative: split the difficult infinitives from their rhetorical context
units.risk: governing syntax, 'Lord does not see/approve,' good/evil, and 3.39 ketiv חטאו/qere חטאיו are hot zones
units.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Complete lamed-mem strophes form anaphoric catalogue plus response; no reading or theology is selected.

units.literary_form: communal self-examination/confession through accusation to singular tears
units.deciding_marker: plural cohortatives/confession run through 3.45; 3.46-48 is a complete pe strophe despite singular 3.48
units.rejected_alternative: cuts at 3.42, 3.46, or before 3.48 would split prayer or pe triplet
units.risk: plural-to-singular speaker shift and perfect tense force remain deferred
units.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Nun-samekh-pe strophes remain whole; pe precedes ayin; cohortatives and plural pronouns mark the turn.

units.literary_form: unceasing tears and pit recollection
units.deciding_marker: eye anaphora across ayin 3.49-51 leads to tsade pursuit/dungeon/waters 3.52-54
units.rejected_alternative: split tears from pit images
units.risk: 'daughters of my city,' historical event, and speaker identity remain unresolved
units.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Ayin follows pe; three ayin and three tsade openings preserve complete triple-acrostic blocks.

units.literary_form: pit call, recalled response, judicial appeal, enemy complaint, imprecation
units.deciding_marker: קראתי opens direct address; qoph-resh-shin-tav sustain you heard/saw/petition through תרדף
units.rejected_alternative: split rescue memory, legal complaint, and imprecation
units.risk: ריב language, מגנת לב at 3.65, temporal force, and imprecatory ethics remain deferred
units.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Four complete triple-letter strophes close poem 3; repeated קרא/שמע/ראה and second-person verbs bind them.

units.literary_form: social-reversal and starvation catalogue culminating in parental horror
units.deciding_marker: third איכה begins value/body reversals and intensifies through famine to 4.10
units.rejected_alternative: separate nobles, infants, rich, famine victims, or mothers
units.risk: opening stone/child imagery, 4.3 ketiv תנין and כי ענים/qere תנים and כיענים, and qinah remain uncertain
units.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Aleph-yod acrostic and value/color/body/hunger contrasts cohere; rare animal terms are translation pressure only.

units.literary_form: wrath summary and prophet-priest bloodguilt/expulsion indictment
units.deciding_marker: כלה יהוה summary and world astonishment lead through causal מחטאות to pollution, exclusion, scattering
units.rejected_alternative: split 4.11-12, indictment, or quoted cries at 4.15
units.risk: 4.12 ketiv וכל/qere כל, 4.16 ketiv זקנים/qere וזקנים, speaker, and moral attribution remain uncertain
units.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Kaph-pe stanzas stay whole; pe at 4.16 precedes ayin; causality/blood/impurity language binds the span.

units.literary_form: communal failed-help watch, pursuit, entrapment, anointed figure captured
units.deciding_marker: explicit first-person plural at 4.17 continues through our pursuit and under-his-shadow expectation
units.rejected_alternative: split foreign help, street/mountain chase, and anointed figure into historical claims
units.risk: 4.17 ketiv עודינה/qere עודינו changes person/number; nation and משיח יהוה identities are non-authorized
units.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Ayin-resh stanzas retain swapped order and plural chain; qere is evidence but ketiv is preserved.

units.literary_form: paired Edom/Zion vocative coda
units.deciding_marker: feminine imperatives to daughter Edom answer with paired Zion/Edom declarations at tav closure
units.rejected_alternative: separate cup address from final paired declaration
units.risk: 4.21 ketiv יושבתי/qere יושבת, temporal force, identity, fulfillment, and ethics remain deferred
units.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Shin-tav stanzas and repeated daughter vocatives bind the coda; no witness is preferred.

units.literary_form: communal direct-address opening and material-deprivation catalogue
units.deciding_marker: זכר יהוה ... הביטה וראה governs plural land/family/water/wood/pursuit/dependence/bread/famine sequence
units.rejected_alternative: split catalogue items or opening imperative
units.risk: qere/ketiv at 5.1/3/5/7, Egypt/Assyria, and intergenerational sin cannot fix chronology/theology
units.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: No full acrostic; plural suffixes bind ten lines. Qere הביטה, ואין, ולא, ואינם, ואנחנו are nonpreferred evidence.

units.literary_form: violated persons and collapsed social life ending at desolate Zion
units.deciding_marker: social-group catalogue 5.11-14 resolves in joy-to-mourning, confession, faint heart/eyes, Zion at 5.15-18
units.rejected_alternative: split each group or isolate 5.16 confession
units.risk: violence terms, collective voice, causality, blame, and historical reconstruction are sensitive
units.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Noun-fronted parallels and plural suffixes cohere; שבת/נהפך/נפלה and repeated על create the summary turn.

units.literary_form: direct closing throne address, protest, restoration petition, unresolved final clause
units.deciding_marker: אתה יהוה renews second person; why-question, השיבנו petition, and difficult כי אם form one tense close
units.rejected_alternative: detach 5.22, replace canonical order with liturgical repetition of 5.21, or split the four lines
units.risk: 5.21 ketiv ונשוב/qere ונשובה and 5.22 כי אם support divergent relations; later Jewish repetition is reception only
units.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Second-person forms bind the close; qere volition and כי אם remain unresolved; complete 22-line parent is preserved.
